title: RecipeRegistry should expose per-recipe revisions for derived evaluation forms
body: The compactor receives sourceRevision, but RecipeRegistry exposes only a global generation; the GPU fixtures use synthetic revisions 1 and 2. Wiring derived recipes into a runtime cache would otherwise need a hand-maintained revision token. Expose a stable per-recipe revision or instruction fingerprint for derived-form identity.

title: Capture runner should place editor script logs where CTest reads them
body: The native capture runner redirects editor stdout to editor.log, while EditorToggleUndoCapture reads run_editor_script.log under the capture directory. Four editor capture assertions failed until the verified editor.log was manually copied to editor/run_editor_script.log. Have the runner expose the log at the path consumed by the CTest assertions.
